facts.title: Chipotle Sauce
ingredients: 2 to 4 tablespoons chipotle peppers in adobo sauce* or chipotle hot sauce, to taste
5 twists of freshly ground black pepper, to taste
facts.author: Cookie and Kate

steps.text: Combine all of the ingredients in a food processor or a bowl (if you’re mixing it with an immersion blender or by hand). Blend or whisk well.

Taste, and if you prefer a spicier sauce, blend in more chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, one tablespoon at a time. Use as desired. Leftover chipotle sauce will keep in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 10 days.

notes: *Ingredient note: If you buy a can of chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, you can use the adobo sauce here or a combination of the peppers and adobo sauce, if you run out of the sauce. Or, use Tobasco brand of chipotle hot sauce instead.

Make it dairy free/vegan: Replace the sour cream with vegan sour cream. You might be happy with the texture without mayonnaise, or you can substitute vegan mayonnaise if you prefer a more silky-smooth texture.
facts.summary: This creamy chipotle sauce is spicy, bold and irresistible! It’s easy to make and packs a punch. Use it on tacos and so much more. This recipe yields ¾ cup and is easily doubled.
